summary: This clinical trial compared a study drug called Insulin Degludec/Insulin Aspart Biosimilar (22011) to another medication named Ryzodeg in adults with type 2 diabetes. Type 2 diabetes is a condition where the body has trouble managing blood sugar levels. The study looked at how well participants' bodies responded to the treatments over time. A total of 414 participants took part in this research across multiple medical centers.
